module.title: MSSQL checker
module.description: Check Microsoft SQL Server: connectivity, databases, backups, agent jobs and custom queries.
module.name: CheckMSSQL

check_mssql.description: Check SQL Server connectivity and health (version, edition, uptime).

check_mssql_query.description: Run a custom T-SQL query and apply thresholds to the returned rows.

check_mssql_databases.description: Check database state, recovery model and data/log size.

check_mssql_backup.description: Check the age of the last full/differential/log backup per database.

check_mssql_jobs.description: Check SQL Server Agent job status.
